_comment: The two static-analysis coverage gaps api-usage.js records, one each, so api-coverage reports two findings and their collapse behaviour is observable: a computed member access (browser.runtime[which]) the resolver cannot follow to a name, and an API object destructured into a binding (const { tabs } = browser) whose later use it cannot track. Both namespaces are permission-free, so the gaps are all that fires here apart from the missing icons key. api-coverage reports only gaps inside the pure WebExtension tree.
